webiq.title: What is Travel Tuesday? Here's when it is in 2026 and how to find the best deals
webiq.snippet:
From cheaper vacation packages to seriously on-sale cruises, Travel Tuesday can save you money on your next trip — if you know what to look for. Below is a breakdown of the Travel Tuesday deals you can expect (some of which are already available) plus expert intel on how to identify a great deal from a just-OK one.

The term Travel Tuesday was coined by Hopper in 2017, when the company compared historical flight data and saw that airlines reduced their rates on the Tuesday after Thanksgiving. The reason airlines were incentivized to offer cheaper airfare on this date, according to Hopper, was that fewer people were booking: many already had their holiday travel plans in place, but hadn't yet booked the following year's travel. ... This year, Travel Tuesday falls on Dec. 1 , right after Black Friday and Cyber Monday. Though some deals won't launch until Travel Tuesday, many companies will begin promotions before then, so plan to keep an eye out. ... Sandals Resorts, for example, launched its Black Friday sale on Nov. 3, which includes $750 in flight credits and up to 65% off qualifying stays.
